body_markdown:
At[Logitech G PLAY 2026](https://www.logitechg.com/campaigns/logitechg-play) , Logitech G unveiled a new sim racing lineup built around a breakthrough in awareness and accessibility: the Logitech G[RS50 McLaren Racing Bundle](https://www.logitechg.com/shop/p/rs50-mclaren-racing-bundle) , PC-only versions of the[RS50 System](https://www.logitechg.com/shop/p/rs50-system) and[G923](https://www.logitechg.com/shop/p/g923-trueforce-sim-racing-wheel) , and the[RS Pedals SE](https://www.logitechg.com/shop/p/rs-pedals-se) . Together, these launches make sim racing more accessible to motorsport fans, more attainable for aspiring racers, and more flexible for PC players who want to pay only for what they need and upgrade at their own pace.


First introduced by Bruce McLaren in the 1960s, the iconic papaya color has become synonymous with six decades of racing heritage, innovation, and peak performance. Champions like McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team Drivers Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri spend hours each week in simulators, refining braking points and testing setup changes through force feedback systems that replicate every kerb strike and tire slip.


That is why the Logitech G RS50 McLaren Racing Bundle matters. It brings the look, energy, and spirit of[McLaren Racing](https://www.logitechg.com/discover/partnerships/mclaren) into the home for motorsport fans and aspiring racers who want to feel closer to the track.


“Sim racing isn’t just about replicating physics; it’s about capturing the emotional connection between driver and machine,” says Richard Neville, Head of Simulation at Logitech G. “The RS50 McLaren Racing Bundle represents years of work translating what professional teams demand into something accessible.”


As an all-in-one setup, this bundle provides everything you need for an unparalleled PC or console racing experience. It includes the RS50 Wheel Base, an 8 Nm Direct Drive system with TRUEFORCE technology for lifelike feedback; the RS Formula Wheel; the RS Wheel Hub with magnetic paddle shifters and fully integrated controls; the RS Pedals with a 75 kg load-cell brake; and all necessary accessories for quick assembly on a rig or table. This complete solution is designed to immerse racing enthusiasts in the thrill of precision driving, offering the tactile satisfaction of mastering each curve, the responsiveness of advanced braking, and the exhilaration of driving a high-performance machine, all from the comfort of your home.


The excitement of motorsport has never been more accessible. Sim racing offers fans and enthusiasts an exhilarating way to experience the precision, energy, and competitive spirit of racing. It brings the excitement of driving legendary cars on iconic circuits directly into your hands, empowering you to refine your skills, test your limits, and immerse yourself in the challenges of the track. Whether you’re a newcomer or a seasoned driver, the expanded Logitech G PC-only lineup provides the flexibility to create a setup tailored to your needs and grow alongside your ambitions.


Sim racing delivers the most authentic connection to motorsport outside of being on the track, transforming every session and lap into a deeply rewarding journey. Designed with choice and simplicity at its core, the new Logitech G PC-only lineup empowers drivers to invest only in what they need, when they need it. This streamlined approach makes the lineup more adaptable, focused, and accessible, so you can stop imagining and start racing.


The lineup also creates a clear path for upgrading at your own pace. Newer drivers can begin with the G923 PC-only, while racers seeking greater power and precision can elevate their setup with the RS50 PC-only System. For those who want the full papaya experience, the RS50 McLaren Racing Bundle delivers a complete setup from day one.


Found in both the RS50 and the G923,[TRUEFORCE](https://www.logitechg.com/discover/technology/trueforce) uniquely connects with in-game physics to deliver a direct, deeper layer of feedback than traditional systems alone. Instead of only feeling broad steering forces, TRUEFORCE improves performance by allowing racers to experience the rumble of the engine, the texture of the asphalt beneath, and the exact moment you accidentally clip a curb, along with every detail in between.


The same pay-for-what-you-need philosophy extends to the new RS Pedals SE. Out of the box, they come with Hall-effect gas and brake pedals, giving drivers a durable, precise two-pedal setup for GT and Formula-style racing. For those who want more advanced braking later, the load-cell brake is available as an optional add-on rather than a required upfront cost. The hall-effect brake can then be repurposed as a clutch for manual shifting.


Logitech G is making sim racing more accessible, easier to grow into, and increasingly rewarding over time. If you have been waiting for the right moment, there’s never been a better time to start racing.
